args.sql:
WITH SiteDensity AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(spc.pointdense) AS avg_density
    FROM 
        scanfeatures sf
    JOIN 
        scanpointcloud spc ON sf.zoneref = spc.arcref
    GROUP BY 
        sf.zoneref
),
ExtractionEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_extraction
    FROM 
        scanfeatures sf
    GROUP BY 
        sf.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    sd.site_code,
    sd.avg_density AS avg_density_value,
    ee.avg_extraction AS avg_extraction_value
FROM 
    SiteDensity sd
JOIN 
    ExtractionEfficiency ee ON sd.site_code = ee.site_code;
